definitions.explanation: A private area in clothing stores where customers can try on clothes.

examples.japanese: {試着室|しちゃくしつ}はどこですか。
{試着室|しちゃくしつ}に{入|はい}って{服|ふく}を{試|ため}した。
examples.english: I went into the fitting room and tried on the clothes.

examples.japanese: {試着室|しちゃくしつ}の{数|かず}が{少|すく}なくて{待|ま}たされた。
examples.english: I had to wait because there weren't many fitting rooms.

notes:
{試着室|しちゃくしつ} is a compound noun: {試着|しちゃく} (trying on clothes) + {室|しつ} (room). Essential vocabulary for shopping at clothing stores.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {試着室|しちゃくしつ}を{使|つか}う: to use the fitting room
- {試着室|しちゃくしつ}が{空|あ}く: a fitting room becomes available
- {試着室|しちゃくしつ}はどこですか: Where is the fitting room?
- {試着|しちゃく}してもいいですか: May I try this on?

SHOPPING PHRASES:
When shopping for clothes, you might hear:
- どうぞ{試着|しちゃく}してください: Please feel free to try it on
- こちらが{試着室|しちゃくしつ}です: The fitting room is this way

RELATED TERMS:
- {試着|しちゃく}する: to try on (clothes)
- {着替|きが}え: changing clothes
- {更衣室|こういしつ}: changing room (at a gym, pool, etc.)
